summary: United Microelectronics Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing the company's consolidated financial statements for the six-month periods ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, accompanied by an independent auditor's review report. This is a routine periodic financial reporting filing by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a quarterly report on Form 10-Q for a domestic U.S. issuer. The filing includes the balance sheet, statements of comprehensive income, changes in equity, and cash flows, along with notes to the financial statements. There is no mention of any special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other transformative transaction. The filing is purely a periodic disclosure of financial results with no event-driven corporate action or structural change. As such, it does not fall into any of the special-situations categories and is classified as 'None.'
